verdict: Fixture is mechanically clean and a blind independent machine reader reproduced 90.5% of its hand-authored labels (kappa 0.901) - the pre-registered top band. This NARROWS the external-validity caveat: the F-EXP11-11 defect class (answer not in option set) is measured absent (0/190), and label noise is not wholesale. It does NOT close it: the pass is a model, not a human annotator, so agreement is NOT inter-annotator agreement and does not discharge PAPER_CANDIDATES.md F.3's call for a second independent labeller. Disagreement is non-uniform and clusters into four conventions; 4 fixture items are flagged for the subject (1 label/rationale tension, 1 self-contradictory premise, 2 self-containment gaps) plus 1 corpus documentation correction (PUBLICATION_STRATEGY.md:46).
limitation: UNVERIFIED AS INTER-ANNOTATOR AGREEMENT. The second labeller is a model, not an independent human annotator. This run cannot establish IAA in the sense a reviewer means and kappa=0.901 must never be reported as such. It provides a machine re-labelling baseline and a disagreement catalogue only. It does not substitute for the second independent human labeller that PAPER_CANDIDATES.md F.3 asks for and that the corpus recorded as absent (UCORR1, 2026-10-14). Pooled kappa is additionally weak on its own (51 of 74 labels occur once; pe=0.040) and must be read with the stratified figures.
